executiveSummary: Today's run is material because the board moved, not because a brand-new employer cluster appeared. On Just Join IT, AI Transformation Lead at Grid Dynamics flipped from PLN/h to EUR/h, and a new Senior MLOps Engineer (Google Cloud) card surfaced with Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise Agent, RAG and MLOps scope. Pracuj.pl also surfaced new relevant cards around NTIATIVE, Sii and Capgemini, while EPAM's AI-native and AI security pages remain live and stable.

changes: The Just Join IT board is still broadly active, but the mix shifted: AI Transformation Lead changed compensation currency, and Senior MLOps Engineer (Google Cloud) is a fresh high-signal addition.
Pracuj.pl now shows a wider Wrocław/remote tail around Sii, NTIATIVE and Capgemini than the previous run highlighted.
EPAM did not materially change status, but the live pages continue to anchor the topic's platform/security watchlist.
risks: Board-first cards can change salary, title or status within a day, so the current compensation wording is not durable.
Some new Pracuj.pl cards are broad AI systems roles rather than pure LLM engineering, so fit needs manual screening.
The AI Transformation Lead salary change may reflect a mirror update rather than an employer-side change, so the canonical page should be checked again next run.
recommendedActions: Re-check Senior MLOps Engineer (Google Cloud) and AI Transformation Lead on the next run for title, salary and expiry drift.
Keep the new Pracuj.pl AI systems tail under observation, especially the NTIATIVE and Sii cards.
Preserve EPAM as a recurring canonical source for AI-native, platform and security roles.
